originality.rationale: Best-knowledge originality: the new result is the full arbitrary-length, arbitrary-initial-state explicit absorption-metric matrix and its exact length-independent optimal sink rate for every nonabsorbing starting site. Riberi treats a semi-infinite path and explicitly proposes finite geometry as future work; Varbanov et al. give general inverse/superoperator theory and small graph examples, not this uniform-adjacency all-size closed form. Krapivsky et al. treat rings/infinite lines with different dark-state structure. Searches of available research claims and published literature found no stronger statement, but independent exhaustive priority verification has not been performed.

value.rationale: Finite geometry is explicitly motivated as an open extension by the 2026 semi-infinite absorber study. The theorem calculates the complete mean-time response for any coherent initial state, rather than a matrix inversion prescription. Its unexpected optimal absorber coupling Ω√(j/(j−1)) is independent of chain length despite mean time growing with length; the absorbing-site exception sharply separates physical Zeno and direct-loss regimes. This provides a natural exact design rule with no artificial truncation or arbitrary sample-size parameter.
